objects.text: Owner accepted the exact stable-native authority and RLVGL-owned bridge/font carrier migration, carrier/fonts first and compatibility after its checkpoint, without changing rendering contracts or relaxing guards.

The July fork-first crate topology and independent Ratatui-repository build
rule cannot carry an unmodified official Ratatui 0.30.2 tree, which has no
`ratatui-rlvgl` member. The owner accepted the concrete PCDN-07 migration plan:
use the unchanged native core contract at e665, own the existing published-name
bridge and scoped compatibility in RLVGL, carry the four exact packed variants
inside that crate, and validate a cold extracted archive through genuine
predecessor/registry routes. The normal protected RLVGL PR is the integration
route; no fork formatting/security route or upstream source patch is resumed.

This named delta replaces only the authority/carrier/font-destination/route
clauses in §§0/5/12 and the companion SCTD-04 clauses. §§6–9's repertoire,
AA/style/variant selection, metrics, caller-driven blink and fallback policy
remain; input, retained-surface ownership, redraw and atomic-frame obligations
also remain. No regeneration, whole-widget-facade equivalence, new target
waiver or unsafe-code authority is granted. Implementation and fresh package,
consumer and full validation results remain unqualified until actually run.
Released A2 and the immutable bridge0.1.1 missing-font evidence are preserved;
July execution receipts and historical reference-map failures are not rewritten.
